title.en: An Act Creating Barrios in the Province of Leyte
title.orig: An Act Creating Barrios in the Province of Leyte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2206_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Lo-ok in the Municipality of Cabucgayan, Province of Leyte, is hereby converted into a barrio to be known as Barrio Lo-ok.

The sitios in the Municipality of Culaba, Province of Leyte, are converted into barrios of the said municipality, as follows:
Sitio Kalipayan to Barrio Kalipayan;
Sitio Bacolod to Barrio Bacolod; and
Sitio Guinadapunan to Barrio Guinadapunan.

The sitios in the Municipality of Biliran, Province of Leyte, are converted into barrios of the said municipality, as follows:
Sitio Bato to Barrio Bato;
Sitio Kanila to Barrio Kanila; and
Sitio Nasonogan to Barrio Nasonogan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 7, 1959.
